claims.claim: Vistra formed Helix Digital Infrastructure with KKR, Kuwait Investment Authority and NVIDIA, with Vistra as preferred power provider, while continuing Cogentrix acquisition and new Permian generation development.

factors.name: AI-load and generation optionality
factors.basis: Helix creates a direct channel between digital-infrastructure development and Vistra power supply while generation expansion increases capacity optionality

risks.risk: Power-market exposure, acquisition integration, permitting and large-load project timing can alter realized economics.

causalEdges.mechanism: large digital loads require reliable power and create opportunities for colocated or contracted generation supply
causalEdges.falsifier: Helix/customer projects fail to convert into material contracted load or generation economics

unknowns.unknown: Helix project-level economics and committed megawatts are not established in the cited release.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA rose more than 30% year over year to $1.767B; Vistra reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $6.8B-$7.6B and adjusted FCFbG guidance of $3.925B-$4.725B, while fleet commercial availability reached at least 97% during recent extreme-heat periods in Texas and PJM.

factors.name: operating execution and reliability
factors.basis: strong EBITDA growth, maintained guidance and high fleet availability support execution quality

risks.risk: GAAP earnings remain sensitive to hedge mark-to-market movements and realized power prices.

causalEdges.from: fleet availability and realized power/capacity prices
causalEdges.mechanism: available generation captures contracted and market power economics
causalEdges.falsifier: adjusted EBITDA/FCF deteriorate despite sustained high availability

unknowns.unknown: No Scout valuation conclusion is asserted.
